meta.sequence_source: UCSC hg19 per-chrom FASTA, downloaded chromosome-by-chromosome and deleted immediately after scoring
meta.leakage_guard: AA/AC DMC1-SSDS strengths are measured readouts; PRDM9-A PWM is frozen from Myers2008 consensus and not fit on Pratto data

frozen_rule.name: Myers2008_PRDM9_A_consensus_scored_PWM
frozen_rule.scoring: scan both strands in +/-500bp window; +1 for fixed consensus matches at C/T positions and +1 for core preferences pos3=T,pos7=C; N positions otherwise untrained

columns_checked: ## This file contains details of the human DSB hotspots used in Pratto et al. 2014.
## Column 1-3: Chromosomal coordinates of each hotspot
## Column 4  : AA1_Strength: Hotspot strength in AA1
## Column 5  : AA2_Strength: Hotspot strength in AA2
## Column 6  : AB1_Strength: Hotspot strength in AB1
## Column 7  : AB2_Strength: Hotspot strength in AB2
## Column 8  : AC_Strength: Hotspot strength in AC
## Column 9  : AA1_hotspots: Hotspots in the AA1
## Column 10 : AA2_hotspots: Hotspots in the AA2
## Column 11 : AB1_hotspots: Hotspots in the AB1
## Column 12 : AB2_hotspots: Hotspots in the AB2
## Column 13 : AC_hotspots: Hotspots in the AC
## Column 14 : AA_hotspots: Hotspots identified in one or both AA
## Column 15 : AB_hotspots: Hotspots found in one or both AB
## Column 16 : A_hotspots_intersect: Hotspots found in all AA1, AA2 and AB1 individuals. Overlapping hotspots are merged (described in supplementary methods)
## Column 17 : A_hotspots_union: Hotspots found in at least one of the AA1, AA2, AB1 and AB2 individuals. Overlapping hotspots are merged (described in supplementary methods)
## Column 18 : A_hotspots_in_AC: AC hotspots that overlap a hotspot in the AA_hotspots_union set
## Column 19 : C_hotspots: AC hotspots that are not found in the AA_hotspots_union set
## Column 20 : AA1_down: Hotspots that are significantly weaker in AA1 relative to AA2 and AB1
## Column 21 : AA1_up: Hotspots that are significantly stronger in AA1 relative to AA2 and AB1
## Column 22 : AA2_down: Hotspots that are significantly weaker in AA2 relative to AA1 and AB1
